event_identity.value: P6 · Mixed Team 10m Air Pistol · WSPS non-Paralympic event
event_identity.locator: §2.1.1 p.11; P6 row and non-Paralympic marker

gender_class.locator: §2.1.1 p.11; P6 row / Gender and Class

caliber_and_energy.value: 4.5 mm (.177); compressed air, CO2 or pneumatic

team_eligibility.value: Two athletes from the same nation: one male and one female; SH1

shot_count.value: 30 competition shots per athlete; 60 per team; each athlete fires independently.

time_and_target_mode.value: 40 minutes for electronic targets; target-carrier/pit-operated: N/A

target_type.value: 10m Air Pistol target; ISSF permits electronic scoring targets or paper for pistol events

team_positions.value: Team members shoot next to each other; female athlete on the left

call_and_setup.value: Call to line 25 minutes before start; 10 minutes for equipment setup

scoring_format.value: Full-ring scoring; team result is the sum of both athletes

maximum_score_rag.value: Per athlete: 30 × 10 = 300; team: 2 × 30 × 10 = 600 points, before penalties/deductions.
maximum_score_rag.locator: Derived RAG calculation from §6.18.2.5(a) p.287, §6.18.2.6 p.287, and full-ring maximum 10 under §6.3.3.1 p.194

ranking_and_tie_break.value: Team total determines ranking; qualification ties use §6.15.5 team procedure

final_qualification.value: Top four teams advance to the Final

series_format.value: P6 rules specify shot count and time limit but no series subdivision.

final.caption: Card P6 — final: fatos e slots preenchidos com regras WSPS e ISSF vigentes incorporadas; comandos de planilha contraditórios não substituem regras normativas.

event_identity.value: P6 · Mixed Team 10m Air Pistol · WSPS non-Paralympic event
event_identity.locator: §2.1.1 p.11; P6 row and non-Paralympic marker

gender_class.locator: §2.1.1 p.11; P6 row / Gender and Class

caliber_and_energy.value: 4.5 mm (.177); compressed air, CO2 or pneumatic

team_eligibility.value: Two athletes from the same nation: one male and one female; SH1

series_and_shots.value: Three 5-shot series per athlete (250 seconds each), then nine single shots per athlete (50 seconds each); 24 shots per athlete, 48 per team

elimination_sequence.value: After 18 shots per athlete: 4th; after 21: bronze; after 24: gold/silver decided

scoring_format.value: Decimal scoring (10.0–10.9); cumulative combined team score

maximum_score_rag.value: Per athlete: 24 × 10.9 = 261.6; team: 2 × 24 × 10.9 = 523.2 points, before penalties/deductions.
maximum_score_rag.locator: Derived RAG calculation from §6.18.3 p.288, §6.18.3.6 p.289, and decimal scale §6.3.3.1 p.194

final_tie_break.value: If tied, each member of tied teams fires additional shots on command until resolved

preparation_sighting.value: Five minutes preparation/sighting; for pistol, CRO starts it after 10 seconds

report_and_setup.value: Report at least 30 minutes before start; equipment may be set at least 15 minutes before; teams assembled about 8 minutes before start

commands_and_roles.value: CRO issues commands; Announcer introduces teams/comments on ranking; each team has one coach and one 30-second timeout; Jury Member in Charge controls timeout

team_ranking.value: Combined cumulative team score determines final ranking

final.source_reconciliation: Final scoring/procedure uses active ISSF Third Print provisions incorporated by WSPS §§1.1.3 and 5.1.8.1; conflicted March 2026 command worksheet is retained as candidate only and does not override the active rule text.
